name: pin-socket
title: Through-hole pin socket
summary: Female pin socket strip: a black PBT housing on the seating plane with, per position, a square entry under a 45° lead-in opening into a cavity, and a gold contact of two leaves on a square tail reaching below the seating plane (rows, pins, pitch, row_pitch, body_height, pin_side, pin_below, lead_in, entry, entry_depth, cavity, leaf, leaf_gap, leaf_width, floor_z, cavity_top, corner_round).
provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at a 1 × 10 socket of 2.54 mm; the header generator gives every parameter its value. Proportions read as a datasheet from Würth Elektronik's WR-PHD 2.54 mm socket header drawing (61301011821, rev. 002.000, 2024-03-25: housing 8.5 mm high and 2.5 mm wide, tails 3.1 mm below the board); the openings and the contact's leaves are estimated. No vendor CAD or EDA/CAD library data copied.
